name: gizza-ai/email-validator
summary: Validate an email address against RFC 5321/5322 syntax and flag common typos.

tool.description: Validate an email address against RFC 5321/5322 syntax rules and flag common typos and formatting issues. Syntax-only (no DNS/SMTP). Reports validity, hard errors, soft warnings, and a suggested fix for likely typos.

email.description: The email address to validate. A 'Name <addr>', 'mailto:addr', or angle-bracketed form is accepted and unwrapped before validation.
